WHAT: Single results grid merging visual matches (from UUID image search) and text search results. Visual results have a frosted 'Visual' badge top-left with CSS tooltip on hover.

WHY: 'TOP MATCHES' section was misleading — watch search would show handbags as 'top matches'. False framing worse than honest mixed results.

TOOLTIP: CSS-only using group-hover/badge pattern in Tailwind — dark pill fades in below badge: 'Matched visually to your photo — may not be exact'. Native title attribute didn't work (suppressed by browser inside <a> tag).

ACCESSORIES: Watch, belt, sunglasses, scarf, necklace — NO visual badge, skip image search entirely. Only clothing, shoes, bags get UUID visual matching.

COMMIT: a6031f1 — 28 files changed, +1088/-428 lines
